description: This Java class provides a helper implementation for integrating with Apache Qpid JMS client in testing Hono messaging system over JMS. It manages connections, sessions, message producers, consumers, and relevant configurations for testing purposes.

classes.name: JmsBasedHonoConnection
classes.description: A helper class for managing JMS connection lifecycle, message creation, and configuration for integration testing of the Hono system using Apache Qpid JMS client.

methods.name: newConnection
methods.description: Factory method to create a new JMS-based Hono connection with provided client configuration.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes JMS context and session asynchronously, returning a Future of the connection.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Method placeholder to add a disconnect listener; not implemented.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Method placeholder to add a reconnect listener; not implemented.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active, returning success or failure Future accordingly.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates JMS connection and session, sets exception listener.

methods.name: createAnonymousProducer
methods.description: Creates a JMS message producer without specifying destination.

methods.name: createProducer
methods.description: Creates a message producer for given destination or queue name.

methods.name: createTelemetryConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for telemetry messages for a specific tenant.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a message consumer for specified destination.

methods.name: newMessage
methods.description: Creates a new BytesMessage with given payload and optional device ID property.

methods.name: getDestination
methods.description: Generates Destination object for a given address or endpoint/tenant.
